title: Boerenpartij en radikalisme ( Krimpenerwaard, Bevermeer ) 1966-1967

descriptions: Developments in farming / attitude towards government agricultural policy / authoritarianism / anomy / political preferences / attitude towards political party 'Boerenpartij'.
